atAGlance: Thịt kho trứng is caramel-braised pork and eggs, usually with coconut water or caramel sauce, fish sauce, and rice.
whatItIs: Thịt kho trứng is pork and eggs braised in fish sauce, caramel, and often coconut water until the braising liquid turns glossy and salty-sweet. It is rice-table comfort food.
howToEnjoy: Break the egg into rice, spoon over a little braising liquid, and use pickles or greens to balance the rich pork.
howLocalsOrder: Order thịt kho trứng when you want homestyle pork-and-egg braise. Ask for extra egg, leaner pork, or extra rice before plating.
worthKnowing: This is family-meal food in Vietnam: sweet-salty braise, egg, pork, and plain rice doing the comforting work together.
goodToKnow: The caramel is savory fish-sauce caramel, not dessert caramel.
